domain(person,[elisabeth,raul,asher,kieran]).

% If Elisabeth owns a big plot of land and needs extra help, then he will employ workers.
axiom(s1, rule([owns(elisabeth,big_plot_of_land), needs(elisabeth,extra_help)], employs(elisabeth,workers))).
% Raul is an experienced farmer.
axiom(s2, experienced(raul,farmer)).
% If Raul manages a large plantation, then he either harvests efficiently or uses sustainable practices, but not both.
axiom(s3, rule([manages(raul,large_plantation)], xor(harvests(raul,efficiently), uses(raul,sustainable_practices)))).
% Raul works independently.
axiom(s4, works(raul,independently)).
% If Raul dedicates time to his farm, then he either grows high-quality beans or supports local projects.
axiom(s5, rule([dedicates(raul,time_to_his_farm)], or(grows(raul,high_quality_beans), supports(raul,local_projects)))).
% Elisabeth needs extra help.
axiom(s6, needs(elisabeth,extra_help)).
% If Asher either employs workers or mechanizes tasks (but not both), then he manages a large plantation.
axiom(s7, rule([xor(employs(asher,workers), mechanizes(asher,tasks))], manages(asher,large_plantation))).
% If Raul is a successful farmer, then he either employs many workers or manages large plantations, but not both.
axiom(s8, rule([successful(raul,farmer)], xor(employs(raul,many_workers), manages(raul,large_plantations)))).
% If Raul owns a big plot of land and needs extra help, then he will employ workers.
axiom(s9, rule([owns(raul,big_plot_of_land), needs(raul,extra_help)], employs(raul,workers))).
% If Asher manages a large plantation, then he either harvests efficiently or uses sustainable practices, but not both.
axiom(s10, rule([manages(asher,large_plantation)], xor(harvests(asher,efficiently), uses(asher,sustainable_practices)))).
% Kieran owns a big plot of land.
axiom(s11, owns(kieran,big_plot_of_land)).
% If Raul is an experienced farmer, then he either grows high-quality beans or harvests efficiently, but not both.
axiom(s12, rule([experienced(raul,farmer)], xor(grows(raul,high_quality_beans), harvests(raul,efficiently)))).
% If Raul either employs workers or mechanizes tasks (but not both), then he manages a large plantation.
axiom(s13, rule([xor(employs(raul,workers), mechanizes(raul,tasks))], manages(raul,large_plantation))).
% Raul needs extra help.
axiom(s14, needs(raul,extra_help)).
% Raul either works independently or shares knowledge with others, but not both.
axiom(s15, xor(works(raul,independently), shares(raul,knowledge_with_others))).
% Raul owns a big plot of land.
axiom(s16, owns(raul,big_plot_of_land)).
% Raul uses sustainable practices.
axiom(s17, uses(raul,sustainable_practices)).
% Raul does not mechanize tasks.
axiom(s18, not(mechanizes(raul,tasks))).
% Asher uses sustainable practices.
axiom(s19, uses(asher,sustainable_practices)).
